correctness.rationale: For finite abelian kernel K and fixed-point-free cyclic H=C_m, δ_h(k)=k^-1k^h is bijective for each h≠1, forcing semiregularity on nonprincipal Irr(K). Clifford/Frobenius reciprocity gives irreducible induced θ^G of degree m with kernel Nθ=intersection of conjugate kernels, and m inflated linear characters exhaust degrees since m+(|K|-1)/m*m²=m|K|. Inflated codegrees divide m and cyclic H has an element of exact codegree order. Induced codegrees |K:Nθ| divide |K|, and commuting Sylow subgroups in finite abelian K supply element with squarefree order supported on exactly those prime factors. The zero/trivial character, arbitrary abelian (not necessarily elementary) K, and m>1 boundaries are correctly handled. Independently enumerated dual orbits/codegrees for C9:C2, C15:C2 and C13:C3; inspected more general frozen artifacts/verify.py including non-elementary kernels. The algebraic proof, not finite examples, covers the entire stated class.
